rows.name: Hand-tied bouquets
rows.descriptionMd: Flowers tied by hand and delivered wrapped, ready to be cut and put into water. Most of our range sits here: roses, tulips, lilies, peonies, sunflowers, gerberas and seasonal mixes, in three stem sizes each. Prices on this page include delivery and local tax, and the size you choose is the size that is made. Every order is made by hand and delivered in person by our florist in the recipient's city.
rows.seoTitle: Hand-tied bouquets: flowers delivered across Europe
rows.seoDescription: Roses, tulips, lilies, peonies, sunflowers and seasonal mixes, tied by hand in three stem sizes. Delivery and local tax included.

rows.name: Arrangements
rows.descriptionMd: Flowers arranged in a box, basket, pot or vase, so nothing has to be trimmed or found on arrival. Useful when the recipient is in hospital, in an office, or unlikely to have a vase to hand. Three sizes on every piece, and where a vase or vessel is part of it the page says so and the price includes it. Every order is made by hand and delivered in person by our florist in the recipient's city.
rows.seoTitle: Flower arrangements: delivered ready to display
rows.seoDescription: Flowers arranged in a box, basket, pot or vase, ready to display with no trimming. Three sizes; any vessel is included in the price.

rows.name: Plants
rows.descriptionMd: Living plants rather than cut flowers: orchids, a peace lily, an anthurium, jasmine, azalea and a small olive. They last months or years instead of days, which is why they are so often sent after a funeral, to a new home or to an office. One size each, potted, with care notes from the person who chose the plant. Every order is made by hand and delivered in person by our florist in the recipient's city.
rows.seoTitle: Flowering plants: orchids, peace lilies and more
rows.seoDescription: Orchids, peace lilies, anthurium, jasmine, azalea and olive, potted and delivered with care notes. Living plants that last months.

rows.name: Funeral and sympathy flowers
rows.descriptionMd: Wreaths, sprays, a cross, a heart, grave bouquets and low memorial arrangements, in the forms each country expects. Tell us the funeral home or cemetery and we time the delivery to the service. Sympathy flowers to a home are here too, for when a framed tribute would be too formal. Every order is made by hand and delivered in person by our florist in the recipient's city.
rows.seoTitle: Funeral and sympathy flowers delivered across Europe
rows.seoDescription: Wreaths, sprays, crosses, hearts, grave bouquets and memorial arrangements in the forms each country expects, timed to the service.

rows.name: Flowers and gift sets
rows.descriptionMd: A bouquet with one thing added: chocolates, a glass vase, a balloon or a small soft toy, chosen to go with the flowers and delivered together. Nothing is shipped separately, so the whole gift arrives at once and in one condition. Sets that contain food carry allergen information at checkout, and every price includes delivery and local tax. Every order is made by hand and delivered in person by our florist in the recipient's city.
rows.seoTitle: Flowers and gift sets: bouquets with chocolates, a vase or more
rows.seoDescription: A bouquet with chocolates, a vase, a balloon or a soft toy, chosen to go with the flowers and delivered together. One delivery, one price, allergen details shown.

rows.name: Birthday flowers
rows.descriptionMd: Bouquets, arrangements and plants people actually send for a birthday: bright tulips and gerberas, pink and orange roses, a mixed bunch chosen on the day, or an orchid for someone who keeps plants. Three sizes on most, and a printed card can be added. Choose where it is going and the day you want, and we take care of the rest. Every order is made by hand and delivered in person by our florist in the recipient's city.
rows.seoTitle: Birthday flowers delivered across Europe
rows.seoDescription: Bright tulips, gerberas, roses, mixed bunches and orchids for a birthday, in three sizes. Pick the date; a printed card can be added.

rows.name: Anniversary flowers
rows.descriptionMd: Red and white roses, peonies in season, lilies and vase arrangements — the flowers sent for an anniversary rather than for a birthday. Several are arranged in a vase, which matters when the delivery is a surprise and nobody is expecting to find one. Prices include delivery and local tax, and the size shown is the size made. Every order is made by hand and delivered in person by our florist in the recipient's city.
rows.seoTitle: Anniversary flowers delivered across Europe
rows.seoDescription: Red and white roses, seasonal peonies, lilies and vase arrangements for an anniversary. Delivery and local tax included in every price.

rows.name: Romantic flowers
rows.descriptionMd: Red roses, deep pink peonies and a rose arrangement in a vase: a short list on purpose, because this is the one occasion where guessing is worse than choosing. Sizes run from twelve stems to twenty-four, and a card in your own words is free. Valentine's Day has its own cutoff, shown on the page for the destination country. Every order is made by hand and delivered in person by our florist in the recipient's city.
rows.seoTitle: Romantic flowers: red roses and peonies delivered
rows.seoDescription: Red roses, deep pink peonies and rose arrangements in a vase, twelve to twenty-four stems. A card in your own words is free.

rows.name: Congratulations flowers
rows.descriptionMd: Bright bouquets, a desk arrangement, a white cube of roses and an orchid — flowers for a new job, an exam passed, a first flat or a business opened. Several are made to sit on a desk without a vase, which is usually where they end up. Three sizes on most, and delivery and local tax are in the price. Every order is made by hand and delivered in person by our florist in the recipient's city.
rows.seoTitle: Congratulations flowers delivered across Europe
rows.seoDescription: Bright bouquets, desk arrangements, white rose cubes and orchids for a new job, an exam or a first flat. Delivery and tax included.

rows.name: New baby flowers
rows.descriptionMd: Pastel bouquets, a small basket of alstroemeria and two gift sets with a soft toy, all tied or arranged light enough to carry with a baby in the other arm. Nothing here is heavily scented. Toys are new and tagged, and if the delivery is to a maternity ward we ask for the ward name at checkout. Every order is made by hand and delivered in person by our florist in the recipient's city.
rows.seoTitle: New baby flowers delivered across Europe
rows.seoDescription: Pastel bouquets, alstroemeria baskets and gift sets with a new, tagged soft toy. Light to carry and never heavily scented.

rows.name: Get well flowers
rows.descriptionMd: Bouquets and arrangements chosen for a hospital room or a sofa: light to carry, low in scent, and several in a box or pot so no vase is needed. Freesias, gerberas, pastel mixes and a peace lily are all here. Some wards do not allow flowers, so check before ordering; we can deliver to a home address instead. Every order is made by hand and delivered in person by our florist in the recipient's city.
rows.seoTitle: Get well flowers delivered across Europe
rows.seoDescription: Bouquets and box arrangements for a hospital room or a sofa: light, low in scent, no vase needed. Freesias, gerberas and pastel mixes.

rows.name: Sympathy flowers
rows.descriptionMd: White lilies, white roses, a peace lily and low white arrangements — flowers sent to a home or an office after a death, rather than to a service. Formal funeral tributes are on the funeral page. If the timing matters, tell us the date and we will not deliver early. Every order is made by hand and delivered in person by our florist in the recipient's city.
rows.seoTitle: Sympathy flowers delivered across Europe
rows.seoDescription: White lilies, white roses, peace lilies and low white arrangements sent to a home or office after a death. Funeral tributes shown separately.

rows.name: Thank you flowers
rows.descriptionMd: Bouquets that read as thank you rather than as anything else: sunflowers, yellow tulips, freesias, orange mixes and a seasonal bunch chosen on the day. Most are in the middle of our price range, and a printed card is included at no cost so the reason arrives with the flowers. Every order is made by hand and delivered in person by our florist in the recipient's city.
rows.seoTitle: Thank you flowers delivered across Europe
rows.seoDescription: Sunflowers, yellow tulips, freesias and seasonal bunches that read as thank you. A printed card is included at no cost.

rows.name: Sorry flowers
rows.descriptionMd: Pale roses, white tulips, freesias and a small box of pastel flowers — quiet rather than grand, which is usually the right register when you are apologizing. A printed card is free and worth using here. Choose where it is going and the day you want, and we take care of the rest. Every order is made by hand and delivered in person by our florist in the recipient's city.
rows.seoTitle: Sorry flowers: apology flowers delivered across Europe
rows.seoDescription: Pale roses, white tulips, freesias and small pastel boxes: quiet rather than grand. A free printed card, and it arrives on the date you pick.

rows.name: Just because flowers
rows.descriptionMd: No occasion at all: a seasonal bunch, a loose mixed bouquet, a small posy or a scented jasmine, mostly at the lower end of our prices so it can be a habit rather than an event. Several are chosen by our florist on the day, which is what makes them look picked rather than ordered. Every order is made by hand and delivered in person by our florist in the recipient's city.
rows.seoTitle: Just because flowers delivered across Europe
rows.seoDescription: Seasonal bunches, loose mixed bouquets, small posies and scented plants, mostly at the lower end of our prices. No occasion needed.

rows.name: Roses
rows.descriptionMd: Roses in red, pink, white, orange and pastel, hand-tied in twelve, eighteen or twenty-four stems, plus rose arrangements in a vase and two white rose tributes. Red roses for romance, white for weddings and sympathy, pink and orange for birthdays and thank yous. The rose itself is fixed on every one of these; only the greenery moves. Every order is made by hand and delivered in person by our florist in the recipient's city.
rows.seoTitle: Roses delivered across Europe: red, pink and white
rows.seoDescription: Roses in red, pink, white, orange and pastel, hand-tied in twelve to twenty-four stems, plus vase arrangements and tributes.

rows.name: Tulips
rows.descriptionMd: Tulips in mixed, yellow, white, pink and purple, bunched in fifteen, twenty-five or thirty-five stems, with their own leaves and no filler. A spring flower: growers change varieties weekly, so we keep the colour and let our florist choose the variety. A spring flower, sold by the bunch rather than by the stem. Every order is made by hand and delivered in person by our florist in the recipient's city.
rows.seoTitle: Tulips delivered across Europe: mixed, yellow and pink
rows.seoDescription: Tulips in mixed, yellow, white, pink and purple, in fifteen to thirty-five stems with their own leaves. Colour fixed; variety by week.

rows.name: Lilies
rows.descriptionMd: Oriental lilies in white and pink, in sheaves of five, eight or twelve stems, and in a glass vase arrangement. Three or four heads to a stem and strongly scented, so a small bouquet fills a room. Sent for sympathy, weddings and anniversaries. Stems arrive part-closed and open over the first few days. Every order is made by hand and delivered in person by our florist in the recipient's city.
rows.seoTitle: Lilies delivered across Europe: white and pink
rows.seoDescription: Oriental lilies in white and pink, in sheaves of five to twelve stems or a glass vase. Strongly scented; buds open over days.

rows.name: Orchids
rows.descriptionMd: Moth orchids in white and pink, single or two-stem, potted and staked, in bud and flower on the day they are delivered. They flower for weeks and need water once a week, which makes them the plant to send when nobody will be home to trim stems. One size each, with care notes. Every order is made by hand and delivered in person by our florist in the recipient's city.
rows.seoTitle: Orchid plants delivered across Europe
rows.seoDescription: Moth orchids in white and pink, single or two-stem, potted and staked, in bud and flower. Flowering for weeks, watered once a week.

rows.name: Sunflowers
rows.descriptionMd: Sunflowers in five, nine or thirteen stems, tied rustic with ruscus, wheat, grasses or orange spray roses depending on the bunch. A summer and early autumn flower, robust in a warm room and hard to make look formal. Sent for birthdays, thank yous, housewarmings and get-well messages. Every order is made by hand and delivered in person by our florist in the recipient's city.
rows.seoTitle: Sunflowers delivered across Europe
rows.seoDescription: Sunflowers in five, nine or thirteen stems, tied rustic with ruscus, wheat, grasses or orange spray roses. Summer and early autumn.

rows.name: Peonies
rows.descriptionMd: Peonies in pink, pale pink and white, in nine, fifteen or twenty-one stems, and in a heavy studio vase. The season is short, a few weeks in late spring, so peony bouquets are only available while it lasts. Priced at the top of our range because the flower is. Every order is made by hand and delivered in person by our florist in the recipient's city.
rows.seoTitle: Peonies delivered across Europe: pink and white
rows.seoDescription: Peonies in pink, pale pink and white, in nine to twenty-one stems or a heavy studio vase. Short late-spring season, no silent swaps.

rows.name: Gerberas
rows.descriptionMd: Gerberas in vibrant and mixed colour, in ten, fifteen or twenty-one stems, plus a low pot arrangement for a desk. One clean head to a stem, no scent, and they last well in a warm office. Sent for get-well messages, birthdays, graduations and congratulations, on their own or with a balloon. Every order is made by hand and delivered in person by our florist in the recipient's city.
rows.seoTitle: Gerberas delivered across Europe
rows.seoDescription: Gerberas in vibrant and mixed colour, ten to twenty-one stems, or a low pot for a desk. No scent, long-lasting in a warm room.

rows.name: Mixed flowers
rows.descriptionMd: Bouquets with no fixed recipe: our florist builds them from what the market had that morning, inside the colour and the size you choose. Pastel, vibrant, orange, white or full mixed, twelve to twenty-four stems. This is the part of the range that looks least like a catalogue, and it is what most people in the trade would send themselves. Every order is made by hand and delivered in person by our florist in the recipient's city.
rows.seoTitle: Mixed flower bouquets delivered across Europe
rows.seoDescription: Bouquets with no fixed recipe, built from that morning's market inside the colour and size you choose. Twelve to twenty-four stems.
